question: Where physician works
evidence: Challenge names Synapse consultation/charting/video/phone/CDS; public page advertises EHR/PACS/SSO integration
conclusion: Synapse is companion context host; hospital EHR remains a separate order/record system
uncertainty: Embedded versus launched surfaces and ownership unresolved
product_implication: Mock Synapse events; distinguish EHR displayed/attempted/saved order
next_validation_step: Sevaro architecture walkthrough and vendor permission matrix

question: Documentation timing
evidence: WakeMed phone, chart review, imaging/cart, recommendation and order signing occur in separate steps
conclusion: A form change may record an already completed clinical action
uncertainty: Sevaro exact autosave / imported timestamp capture unknown
product_implication: Keep occurred_at and documented_at; late action yields discrepancy notice
next_validation_step: Observe clinicians and map action-time capture for every trigger

question: Native application integration
evidence: Challenge supplies context per field/step and requires completion attempt handling
conclusion: Preferred prototype route: native mock event adapter and client-side preloaded rules
uncertainty: No public Sevaro plugin/event contract verified
product_implication: Expose typed form lifecycle and atomic completion check
next_validation_step: Confirm callbacks, identity binding, and intercept contract with Sevaro

question: CDS Hooks
evidence: Standard has workflow hooks/context/prefetch and sourced cards
conclusion: Useful supported EHR workflow integration if host implements needed hooks
uncertainty: Host hook list and unsaved edits unavailable; no guarantee of blocking
product_implication: Negotiate exact hook/version and do not map critical card to hard stop automatically
next_validation_step: Host capability discovery and round-trip latency test

question: FHIR event feed
evidence: R5 subscriptions notify supported topic changes
conclusion: Useful for saved resource events and reconciliation
uncertainty: FHIR version/topic availability and notification delay unknown
product_implication: Use as back-end evidence updates, not assumed 500ms form-event path
next_validation_step: Server capability statement, supported topics, failure/replay tests

question: SMART launch
evidence: SMART negotiates launch context and resource authorization
conclusion: Can bind supported encounter context and read permitted resources
uncertainty: Does not supply arbitrary form focus/change events
product_implication: Use least needed read scopes; explicit missing encounter handling
next_validation_step: Test actual host launch context and authorization

question: Browser extension
evidence: Chrome supports DOM content scripts with isolated JS environment
conclusion: Possible observational prototype for authorized browser app
uncertainty: DOM drift, frames, app state and bypass paths undermine completion enforcement
product_implication: Permission review; stable selectors and host contract needed; no production gate from DOM alone
next_validation_step: Mutation, navigation, multi-tab and bypass tests

question: Screen observation
conclusion: Observation alone is inadequate for authoritative gate
uncertainty: Occlusion, visual ambiguity, latency and permissions; no Sevaro interface verified
product_implication: Use only assistive guidance after consent; no autonomous click/order/gate
next_validation_step: Compare sampled observation to native truth

question: Information capture
evidence: Public Sevaro advertises automated capture and AI documentation
conclusion: Capability claim exists; per-field provenance remains unknown
uncertainty: Manual/imported/auto/AI origin cannot be assumed per field
product_implication: Mark source kind unknown until real connector confirms; clinician validates AI draft
next_validation_step: Vendor field lineage and correction workflow review

question: Completion authority
evidence: N5/N7 explicitly block before required charge/plan confirmation
conclusion: Gate is a deterministic host-owned check of current prerequisites
uncertainty: Brief says acknowledge or fix; examples say until condition satisfied
product_implication: Acknowledgement logs review, not completion; explicit override policy unresolved

question: Low latency
evidence: Preload and <=500ms mandated; CDS Hooks supports prefetch rationale
conclusion: Evaluate compiled known rules locally; LLM extraction out of critical path
uncertainty: No prototype runtime supplied or measured yet
product_implication: Instrument trigger-to-visible paint, including dedupe and changed context
next_validation_step: PERF-01/PERF-02 across slow CPU, burst edits and guide failure

question: Scope of care
evidence: OHSU local provider responsibility; UPMC sometimes no video
conclusion: Video end cannot signal care, transfer or documentation completion
product_implication: Model consult lifecycle separately from video lifecycle
next_validation_step: Validate who confirms disposition and plan
